question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **mismatche**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are as follows:
 
 
• **Mismatch:** a combination of things or people that do not go well together or are not suitable for each other. अनुपयुक्त मेल; बेमेल
 
 
 
• Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is given in **option 1**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Securities: **fungible and tradable financial instruments used to raise capital in public and private markets. प्रतिभूतियां
 
• **Essentially: **when you consider the basic or most important part of something. मूल रूप से, मूलतः
 
• **Fiscal: **connected with government or public money, especially taxes. सरकार या सार्वजनिक धन (विशेषतः करों) से संबंधित; राजवित्तीय
